title: Simple Role Assignment is Extraordinarily Effective for Safety Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to potentially biased prompts by measuring Defense Success (DS) on the SafeEdit benchmark, using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-large evaluator to classify the safety and fairness of role-conditioned outputs.

Assessing model generation behavior on politically sensitive topics by measuring Defense Success (DS) on the 'Political Sens.' category of the SafeEdit benchmark using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-large evaluator.
